summary:
Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature without committing or running anything. Changes: (1) rich/tree.py: added Tree.__rich_measure__, an iterative depth-first walk with an explicit stack and level counter, adding 4 cells per indent level; imported Measurement. (2) rich/align.py: added Align.__repr__; Align.__rich_console__ now constrains the wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (or the smaller of that and an explicit width); added public VerticalCenter with __init__, __repr__, __rich_console__ (newline-segment padding using console.size.height), and __rich_measure__, placed before the main guard. (3) rich/console.py: print now renders collected renderables with justify="default" while still passing justify into _collect_renderables. (4) CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 marked Unreleased, with an Added subsection listing the two entries. (5) tests/test_align.py: added repr, VerticalCenter render (expects "

foo


" at height 6), and VerticalCenter measure tests. tests/test_tree.py: added Measurement import and a tree measurement test expecting Measurement(11, 19). Verification: none; tests were not run per instructions, so results are checked by reading only. Likely failure points are the exact newline count and the tree measurement values, both hand-checked against the spec formulas. Minor note: the Tree walk pops the root iterator, leaving level at -1 after the loop, which is harmless.
